name: Setting up your testing framework
prompt: Set up a testing framework for the Sudoku logic and verify the app can generate valid puzzles while checking that the rules and flow work correctly.

name: Ensuring the Sudoku board has only one unique solution
prompt: Review the Sudoku generator and confirm it creates a valid board with exactly one unique solvable solution. Add checks to validate uniqueness and explain edge cases if needed.

name: Checking for a top 10 score and storing the top 10 in local storage
prompt: Implement or review the score logic so the app checks for a top 10 score and stores the top 10 entries in localStorage using player name, time, hints used, and difficulty.

name: Styling the grid so the 3x3 squares have different colors
prompt: Style the Sudoku grid so each 3x3 square has a distinct background color without causing layout shifts, while keeping the board readable in light and dark modes.

name: Evaluating or rejecting a Copilot suggestion
prompt: Review a proposed code change critically. If it introduces brittle logic, poor accessibility, or invalid Sudoku state handling, reject it and explain why before revising the implementation.
